title: Works for me
body: The app unexpectedly works for me, both for ios and android. I strongly suggest to add a note feature and/or sub todo also in the to do section and also a search bar to navigate past entries (both for routines and todos, and can also easily find notes). And for both routines and notes I would like it more if we can add media or links. I hope there will be an update soon with these features because I love using the app.
author: noitsbecky123

title: Not friendly with people that work or awake at night
body: Im not sure but it seems that the only applicable routines are for people that start their day in the morning and not at night, will change my review if you add this version in the app
author: JolliBaka
